WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     DATE_DIFF('year', STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), DATE '2026-10-14') -
     CASE WHEN STRFTIME(DATE '2026-10-14', '%m-%d') < STRFTIME(STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d'), '%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH nationality,
     2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2
